source: 2. How is context engineering broader than prompt engineering, and where does ZXNAME0000XZ fit inside it? [Intermediate] Prompt engineering is mainly about writing and organizing instructions. Context engineering is broader: it is the design of the complete token state presented to the model at inference time - instructions, retrieved evidence, tool results, conversation state, metadata, examples, and other information that may affect behavior. ZXNAME0001XZ is one mechanism for acquiring part of that context from an external corpus. A good ZXNAME0002XZ retriever can still produce a poor system if the retrieved passages are badly ordered, redundant, overlong, stale, unauthorized, or mixed with ambiguous instructions. Conversely, context engineering can exist without vector retrieval at all; a system may load files just in time, use structured queries, cached context, or tool outputs. The practical goal is not to maximize context length. It is to supply a small enough, high-signal context that is sufficient for the task and safe for the model to use. [2]
zh: 2. 上下文工程比提示工程更广泛，ZXNAME0000XZ 在其中的位置如何？ [中级] 即时工程主要是编写和组织指令。上下文工程更广泛：它是在推理时呈现给模型的完整令牌状态的设计 - 指令、检索到的证据、工具结果、对话状态、元数据、示例和其他可能影响行为的信息。 ZXNAME0001XZ 是一种从外部语料库获取部分上下文的机制。如果检索到的段落顺序错误、冗余、过长、过时、未经授权或混有不明确的指令，那么一个好的 ZXNAME0002XZ 检索器仍然会产生一个糟糕的系统。相反，上下文工程可以在根本没有矢量检索的情况下存在；系统可以及时加载文件、使用结构化查询、缓存上下文或工具输出。实际目标不是最大化上下文长度。它是提供一个足够小的、高信号的上下文，足以完成任务并且模型可以安全使用。 [2]
